stem:
A student drops five objects into a container of water.

Which statement BEST classifies some of these objects?

options.label: A
options.text: Objects 2 and 5 are more dense than water, while Objects 1 and 4 are less dense than water.

options.label: B
options.text: Objects 1 and 4 are more dense than water, while Objects 2 and 3 have the same density as water.

options.label: C
options.text: Objects 2 and 3 are less dense than water, while Object 5 is more dense than water.

options.label: D
options.text: Objects 1 and 4 are less dense than water, while Object 2 is more dense than water.

visual_elements: Beaker with five objects labeled 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 showing their relative positions in water
